description: Zillow's Economic Research team publishes real estate metrics including median home values and rents, inventory, sale prices and volumes, negative equity and home value forecasts, as free CSV downloads. Most series are available at neighbourhood, ZIP code, city, county, metro, state and national levels, and many start in the late 1990s. The data are free for public use by consumers, media, analysts, academics and policymakers under Zillow's terms of use, with clear attribution to Zillow required; the developer page also points to separate APIs for public records and neighbourhood data. Coverage: the United States. Access: CSV downloads from the research data page. Licence: Zillow terms of use with attribution; free. Caveats: zillow.com pages returned 403 here, so facts come from the Zillow Group developer page; indices are modelled. Simulation uses are property value exposure for flood and hazard loss studies, and tracking post-disaster housing market recovery. Related records: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data and the Eurostat house price index.
